extracted.intended_audience: short-story authors, magazine editors, and bibliographers/researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A yearbook-style directory and bibliographical Roll of Honor for American short stories (Oct. 1919–Sept. 1920), giving magazine addresses and indicating selection/notation conventions for the Roll of Honor. Useful for authors seeking markets and for researchers tracking notable stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address-list scope disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Note. This address list does not aim to be complete, but is based simply on the magazines which I have consulted for this volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that the market directory is selective and limited to the compiler's surveyed magazines; not an exhaustive market list. Use as a representative, not comprehensive, listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality restriction for Roll of Honor
rubrics_metrics.description: Only stories by American authors are listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Bibliographical Roll of Honor excludes non‑American authors entirely; selection and the accompanying index apply only to American writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marking of best stories
rubrics_metrics.description: The best stories are indicated by an asterisk before the title of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A simple editorial notation: an asterisk (*) before a story title denotes the compiler's judgment that the story is among the best in the period covered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index-figure notation for prior inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The index figures 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 prefixed to the name of the author indicate that his work has been included in the Rolls of Honor for 1914, 1915, 1916, 1917, 1918, and 1919 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric prefix on an author’s name conveys historical metadata — which earlier Rolls of Honor included that author's work. Useful for tracking recurring recognition over years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of reprints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only original first appearances (not reprinted material) are considered for inclusion in the Roll of Honor; reprinted stories are intentionally omitted.
